explanation: The thirteen App-rendering tests await preloadAppViews() in a beforeAll, because App now renders its views as lazy chunks and these tests query them synchronously; the merge with main keeps its deletion of the Statistics and Data Sources tests and its removal of the Compare-as-bars mock. lazyView.test.tsx covers the fallback, synchronous render after preload, no remount when the chunk lands, and a failed download that is reported once and retried only on the boundary reset. originHealth.test.ts expects the HEAD probe.
